title: [DOCS] Changelog does not indicate when Claude 2.0.x started eagerly compressing
body:
### Documentation Type

Missing documentation (feature not documented)

### Documentation Location

https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

### Section/Topic

I don't know which date is implicated

### Current Documentation

_No response_

### What's Wrong or Missing?

Claude 2.0.{something} started eagerly auto-compressing context, leading many users to quickly exhaust Opus credits (#9424, #8604, #8644).

To work around I am trying to pin Claude to a version before this regression. The changelog is missing information indicating when this regression occurred.

### Suggested Improvement

Please don't dismiss us users with "don't use opus". I'm using Opus to code review manually derived gradients in C++. Opus 4.1 is ok at this mathematically intensive task, whereas Sonnet 4.5 is very bad at this task. I don't need context compression, I just need 0.3-0.5 of a context of Opus to review code. 🙏 

### Impact

Medium - Makes feature difficult to understand

### Additional Context

_No response_
